Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! Indian players are out there in the middle. Pathum Nissanka and Kamil Mishara are the openers for Sri Lanka. Bhuvneshwar Kumar to start with the ball for India. Here we go...
...THE RUN CHASE…

Sri Lanka, after electing to bowl, will be disappointed. They did not begin well and leaked runs in the Powerplay. They did manage to pull things back in the middle overs courtesy Lahiru Kumara, Jeffrey Vandersay and Shanaka but all the good work was given away as the death bowling was not at all good. In the end, they now face a stiff task ahead and will have to bat out of their skins if they are to chase this down. They need good start to get anywhere close to this target. Stay tuned as for an entertaining second-half of this game.

It all began with the openers who put up a 100-run stand. Kishan was the aggressor and Rohit played second fiddle. Once Rohit fell, there was a quiet period for India where Kishan and Iyer were finding it difficult to maintain the same tempo. Kishan fell 12 short of his ton trying to up the ante but then Iyer exploded. He found the boundaries at ease and gave India a solid finish to get them close to 200.
What a performance with the bat by India. Scoring 199 on this big ground on a wicket which hasn’t looked the easiest, is a tremendous effort. They will be very pleased with their outing.

So a single to end the innings! A low full toss outside off. Jadeja pulls this hard but it goes towards long on for a single. This has been a superb batting performance by India. India finish with 199/2 after 20 overs!
Just a single this time! A fuller delivery on middle. Iyer flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
A fuller delivery outside off. Iyer drills it to deep extra-cover for a couple.
FOUR! Another boundary, fine leg is inside the circle and Dushmantha Chameera bowls this on leg. Iyer just flicks it past short fine leg for a boundary.
Fifty for Iyer! He has paced this innings superbly! A fuller delivery on middle. Iyer flicks it to deep square leg for a couple.
SIX! Another monstorous hit! A slower length delivery around off, in the slot. Iyer tonks it over long on for a biggie.
A full delivery on off. Iyer drills it to long off for a single.
FOUR! Nice shot again by Iyer! A full delivery and wider outside off. Iyer opens the face of his blade and gets this in the gap through the third man region for a boundary.
A shorter length delivery on off now. Jadeja pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
A full delivery on off. Iyer drills it to long off for a single.
WIDE! A full delivery and way outside off. Iyer leaves it alone.
FOUR! Poor bowling this! A low full toss outside off. Iyer just slices it to deep backward point for a boundary.
SIX! BANG! Iyer is in his groove now!  A length delivery on off. Iyer gets under it and launches it over long on for a biggie.
A fuller delivery outside off. Jadeja goes for the sccop as he gets across but misses.
A fuller delivery on off. Iyer pushes it to long off for a single.

DROPPED!! A fuller delivery on off. Iyer looks to work it towards the leg side but gets a huge leadinng edge towards deep extra-cover. The fielder runs back from the ring to catch it and gets a hand on it but fails to pouch it. Two runs taken.
FOUR! A short ball and punished. Chameera goes short on off. Iyer pulls it to deep square leg for a boundary. Good shot.

A length delivery around off. Iyer dabs it to backward point and sets off for a single. There is a shy at the bowler's end but there is no one backing up and the batters take an extra run off an overthrow.
A fuller delivery outside off. Jadeja drills it to deep cover for a single.
Ravindra Jadeja is the next man in.

OUT! TAKEN! Ishan Kishan misses out on the hundred but it has been a brilliant knck by the youngster! Shanaka bangs this short on middle. Kishan looks to pull but gets a huge top edge this time. The ball goes high in the air towards deep square leg and Janith Liyanage there takes a good catch. So the Sri Lankan skipper provides the breakthrough.
Commentary.Howout: c Janith Liyanage b Dasun Shanaka

Commentary.Commentary: A fuller delivery on off. Iyer mistimes his slog to long on for a single.
FOUR! Ohh..great shot and great understanding of the field there by Iyer! A fuller delivery on off. Iyer gets across and flicks it to deep square leg for a boundary.
Another good delivery ! A very full delivery, wide outside off. Iyer goes chasing for it but misses.
Shorter length delivery on off. Kishan pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
WIDE! A slower short ball and a bit too high this. Kishan leaves it alone.
A brilliant yorker outside off. Iyer digs it out to short third man for a single.
Dasun Shanaka is back on. He went for 11 runs in his first over.
A Slower short delivery on off. Iyer pulls it to long on and gets a single. 17 runs from the over.
A wide yorker this time, outside off. Kishan digs it out to sweeper cover for a single.
FOUR! Oh...this is fabulous batting from Kishan! A low full toss outside off. Kishan gets across and sweeps it to deep mid-wicket for another boundary.
FOUR! A boundary again! A wide fullis delivery outside off over 140 clicks! Kishan just guides this past short third man for a boundary.
SIX! This time he connects it quite well and gets the maximum! A slower full ball, on middle. Kishyan gets under it and tonks it over long on for a maximum.
Iyer backs away and Kumara follows him. Serves this on his leg. Iyer flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
Shorter and around off this time. Kishan looks to cut but misses.
A tossed up delivery outside off. Iyer lifts this towards deep extra cover for a single.
Two wides! A fuller delivery down the leg side. Kishan looks to sweeps it but misses. The keeper fails to collect it cleanly too and the batters run a bye.

NOT OUT! Tossed up around off. Googly again. Kishan makes room and looks to hit it towards the off side but misses. There is an appeal for stumping. The leg umpire takes it upstairs. The replays roll in and the UltraEdge shows no bat involved and his leg is also inside the crease as the bails are whipped off. So he will continue.
Nicely tossed up outside off at 82.5 kph. Iyer drives it to long off for a single.
A low full toss around leg. Kishan flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Shorter and outside off this time. Kishan looks to heave it across the line but misses.
A slower full delivery on off. Kishan drills it to long on for a single. Good over by Chamika Karunaratne.
Again hit hard but no run! Back of  a length, on off. Kishan hits this hard back to the bowler this time.
A slower length delivery on middle. Kishan looks to pull but mistimes it towards the leg side.
Hit hard but straight to the fielder at the covers in the ring! A length delivery on off. Kishan dances down the track and smahes it to covers.
Slightly fuller this time on middle. Iyer flicks it to deep square leg for a single this time.
On a length, on middle. Iyer flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a couple.
Dot to end! Looks to okay the reverse sweep but this is bowled full and down the leg side. Kishan swings but misses.
UNDEREDGE AND FOUR! Kishan steps out, this one stays low, Kishan looks to heave it but it goes off the underedge down to the third man fence.
Two more! On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for two.
A single as this is worked through mid-wicket.
Flatter and on off, Iyer guides it to point.
Two more! On middle, this is worked wide of mid-wicket.
Iyer is off the mark! Shorter and on off, this is played to point. The fielder dives and stops it.
Shreyas Iyer walks in at number 3.

OUT! TIMBER! Stop the press, Sri Lanka have managed to break the opening stand. It has done its job though but they can surely pull things back a little now. This one has stayed very low. On off, no bounce at all. Rohit looks to go over mid off but it sneaks under the bat and hits the off pole.
Just the one! Fuller and on off, Kishan hits it hard to mid off for one.
Just the one again! Shorter and outside off, Sharma was aiming for the leg side but this is short and outside off, he guides it down to third man for one.
Shorter and outside off, Kishan pushes it through covers for one more.
Two more! Fuller and outside off, this is timed beautifully through covers. The fielder in the deep does well in the deep. Two taken.
Kishan skips down the track tad early this time. The bowler follows him and darts this on leg. Kishan works it to deep square leg for a single.
A fuller delivery on off. Sharma drives it to sweeper cover for a single.
Ishan Kishan seems to be in some pain here! He is getting some tretament on his left leg now as the physio is out.  He looks fine now and is ready to resume.
A flatter delivery on middle. Kishan works it to deep square leg and looks for the second run but has to settle for a single.
Tossed up on middle. Kishan makes room and drives it inside out towards deep extra-cover. The long off fielder runs to his right and puts in a great dive and saves two runs for his team.
Great effort in the deep by Charith Asalanka! 100 up for India! A fuller delivery around leg. Kishan sweeps it to deep backward square and gets a couple as the fielder does well to stop it.
A flatter delivery on middle. Sharma works it to deep mid-wicket for a single.

Drinks! This has been a dominating start from India! Both batters took couple of overs to get going but once they got into their groove, Sri Lankan bowlers were carted all around the park. Kishan did get a life and he will now look to make most of it. Can Sri Lanka fight back in this second-half of this innings? Praveen Jayawickrama is back on.
FOUR! That has been hit with some power and it races away. On middle, Kishan whips it through mid-widket. No chance for the fielder in the deep.
On middle, this is nudged through square leg for one.
Two! On middle, Rohit works it through mid-widket, in the gap and a big ground and hence, a boundary.
This one stays low too! On middle, Kishan works it towards mid-wicket for one.

Fifty for Kishan! A superb innings from him, yes he did get a life but has played brilliantly. Also, a much-needed one for him as he has been short of runs. He gets a short ball outside off which he slaps it through covers for two. Has a chance now to make this a big score.
On a length, on off. Sharma looks to work it towards the leg side but gets a leading edge towards the off side for a single.
Tossed up outside off. Sharma creams it to deep cover for just a single now.
Tossed up outside off. Sharma thinks of chasing it but leaves it alone.
SIX! Another good shot from Sharma! Tossed up delivery on off and it's a googly this time. Sharma gets low and slog-sweeps it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
A tossed up delivery on middle. Kishan lifts this aerially to long on for a single.
A fuller delivery around leg. Kishan looks to sweep but misses and the ball hits his pads. It is going down leg.
Just over! Outside off, this one turns away a little. Sharma looks to go over covers, he ends up squirting it over point for three.
A single to end as this is guided down to third man.
FOUR! That is brilliantly played! Shorter and on the body, this is pulled behind square on the leg side. Races away.
Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through mid-wicket for one.
A dot! On off, this is pushed to covers.
A single! On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Two! Good fielding! Fuller and on off, this is driven through covers. The fielder in the deep, runs to his right and dives, keeps it down to two.
Chamika Karunaratne is back on. He went for 15 runs in his first over.
Another single as this is eased to long off. A wicket could have been taken in this over but instead it goes for runs.
On middle, this is worked down to long on for one.

PUT DOWN! That is well bowled! Slows it up and bowls it outside off, Kishan drags it towards deep mid-wicket. Janith Liyanage runs in, makes a lot of ground and slides to take it but spills it. Should have hung on in the end. This could prove very costly.
FOUR! That is a hit-me ball. Shorter and wider outside off, it is slapped through covers for a boundary.
On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket for one.
On off, this is pushed to covers.
TWO MORE! A low full toss, this is timed down the ground. The fielder at mid off dives but he has no chance. The fielder at long on runs after it and stops it.
Good reply! Length and on off, Kishan plays it back to mid off.
SIX! All the way. Kishan is in his element now. Fifty up for India. Short and on the body. This is pulled over the square leg fence for a biggie
Well bowled! A yorker outside off, Kishan looks to jam it out but misses.
Outside off, Rohit takes one as he guides it through point.
IN THE AIR BUT SAFE! On middle, this is flicked up in the air but it clears mid on. Two taken.
A dot to end! On middle, this is hit hard back to the bowler. Kishan is going after everything.
FOUR! Thumped! Fuller and on middle, this is hammered down to the long off fence for a boundary.
Gets his bat down in time! This is a yorker, on middle, Kishan gets his front leg out of the way and jams it to mid-wicket.
Angled into the pads, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through mid-wicket for one.
Rohit steps out but the length is shortened. It is pushed to mid off.
FOUR! He is getting into his groove now!  A fuller delivery on middle. Kishan flicks it to deep square leg for a boundary now.
SIX! BANG! A short delivery on middle this time. Kishan rocks back and pulls it over deep square leg for a biggie.
A slower length delivery on middle. Sharma works it to square leg for a single.
WIDE! A slower fuller delivery down the leg side. Sharma looks to flick it but misses.
A fuller delivery on off at 147.4 kph. Kishan drives it to mid off and takes a single. There is a direct hit at the bowler's end but Kishan is well inside his crease.
A length delivery around off at 147.8 kph. Kishan looks to punch it away but gets beaten off the inside edge.
A length delivery on middle. Sharma flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Lahiru Kumara will continue.
A fuller delivery on off. Sharma looks to work it towards the leg side but gets the inside edge onto his pads. A run taken towards the off side. 15 runs from the over!
On a length, around off again. Kishan steers it to backward point for a single now.

FOUR! Three in a row now! Ishan Kishan will be feeling much better now! A length delivery outside off. Kishan throws his bat at it and gets this in the gap between backward point and short third man for a boundary.
FOUR! Another boundary now! Chamika Karunaratne pulls his length back and provides some width there. Kishan cuts it  through covers for a boundary.
FOUR! Finally Kishan finds the gap and gets his first boundary! A low full toss outside off. Kishan leans foward and creams it through covers for a lovely boundary.
A fullish delivery this time on off. Slower in pace at 114.7 kph. Kishan drives it to covers now.
WIDE! Chamika Karunaratne starts with a shorter delivery down the leg side. Kishan looks to pull but misses.
Back of a length, outside off. Sharma cuts it to point this time. He looks disappointed with his shot there.
Another delivery that is on a shorter side at 143.2 kph. Kishan pulls it to deep square leg this time for a single.
A short ball this time on off. Kishan pulls it without much timing to mid on.
Beaten this time! A good-length delivery outside off. Kishan looks to cut it but misses.
Back of a length, on middle. Sharma pulls it to deep square leg for a single.

FOUR! First boundary of the game and Hitman flicks this beautifully! A fuller delivery on middle. Sharma flicks it towards deep backward square leg. The fielder in the deep runs to his right and puts in a dive but fails to stop it.
Lahiru Kumara will share the new ball with Dushmantha Chameera.
A fuller delivery on middle. Kishan drives it to mid on this time. Decent start by Dushmantha Chameera.

This time he hits this over the infield! A fuller deivery on off. Sharma drives it uppishly over cover-point and gets three runs. The boundaries are long here and we will see many of these three's today.
Kishan is off the mark straightaway! A fuller delivery on off. Kishan blocks it out towards the leg side for a single.

Rohit Sharma and India are underway! A fuller delivery on off. Sharma drives it left of mid off and takes a single. Shanaka there fumbles a little and a single is taken after initial mix-up between the batters.
On a length, this time on off. Sharma blocks it out to mid off. Not much swing in the first couple of balls.
Dushmantha Chameera starts with a fullish delivery on middle. Sharma leans forward and drives it towards the off side.

So we are done with national anthems and the action is all set to begin at Lucknow! Sri Lankan players make their way out to the middle. Rohit Sharma and Ishan Kishan are the openers for India. Sunil Gavaskar rings the bell as a symbol for play to start. Dushmantha Chameera will start with the ball for Sri Lanka. Here we go...
The two teams are now assembling for their respective national anthems. It will be Sri Lanka's national anthem first up, followed by the Indian national anthem.

Shreyas Iyer is down for the chat. He says that he is comfortable in the number 3 position and this position gives more time to settle and then launch. He mentions that he was quite flamboyant at the start of his career but he is now more calm in his approach. He mentions that in this format it is important to not think too much and just react to the situation. He says he enjoys playing leg spinners but tells that it depends on the situation but he prefers a leg spinner anyday and likes going after them.

Rohit Sharma, the Indian skipper, says that he was looking to chase. He says that he was not sure about the pitch and he says that the last time they played here the pitch was good. He mentions that nothing changes for them and he adds that it is important they stay in the radar and they want to keep ticking the boxes. He mentions that this is a good opportunity for younger  guys. He informs that they have made six changes from the last game and Ruturaj Gaikwad was about to play but has injured his wrist before the game.

Dasun Shanaka, the Sri Lankan skipper, says that they will bowl first. He says that they are bowling well in the last few games and they are confident. He adds that Australia was a tough tour and they could have won more games there. He informs that they have few changes from the last time they played.

India (Playing XI) - Rohit Sharma (C), Ishan Kishan (WK), Shreyas Iyer, Sanju Samson, Venkatesh Iyer, Deepak Hooda, Ravindra Jadeja, Harshal Patel, Bhuvneshwar Kumar, Jasprit Bumrah, Yuzvendra Chahal.

Sri Lanka (Playing XI) - Pathum Nissanka, Kamil Mishara, Charith Asalanka, Janith Liyanage, Dinesh Chandimal (WK), Chamika Karunaratne, Dasun Shanaka (C), Jeffrey Vandersay, Praveen Jayawickrama, Lahiru Kumara, Dushmantha Chameera.
TOSS - The coin goes up and lands in favour of Sri Lanka. They have elected to FIELD first.

PITCH REPORT - Deep Dasgupta is down for the pitch report. He says the match is on the black soil pitch. He says that the right boundary is short and the left is long. He mentions that the straight at Lucknow is the longest in the country. Russel Arnold joins him and he says that the conditions are good and there will not be much dew. He informs that the pitch is hard and there will be a nice pace and bounce. He recokns that 180 is a par score today.

Sri Lanka, on the other hand, will head into this game with some confidence. They beat Australia in their last game and in conditions which are kind of familiar to home, they would feel they could do better here. They too will take this series as one to prepare for the upcoming T20 World Cup. Toss and teams in a bit.

With a few big names missing, India will yet again look to test their bench strength. Saying that, the likes of Bumrah is back yet again to lead the bowling attack. However, Samson returns into the line-up and will probably be picked in the XI. This is a good chance for him to make a statement before the grandest stage.

India’s preparation for the upcoming T20 World Cup continues. It was West Indies who visited a little while ago and now it is their neighbours Sri Lanka who head here to play 3 T20Is and two Tests. On that note, hello and a warm welcome to the coverage of the first T20I between India and Sri Lanka.
... MATCH DAY …
